title: Outside-Lender and Cash Buyers: Additional Deposit Rate on the Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Lending liaison note.** The additional deposit rate of a Home Purchase Agreement is uplifted by how the buyer finances, read from the agreement's financing type and its deposit ledger:

- where the agreement's financing type is **outside lender** and an outside-lender deposit stands on the ledger — that is, outside-lender deposits posted exceed those returned unpaid — **0.5 percentage points** are added to the additional deposit rate;
- where the financing type is **cash**, **0.3 percentage points** are added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

The outside-lender deposit is the extra deposit posted for outside-lender or cash financing.

## Decision table

| Financing type | Outside-lender deposits posted exceed those returned unpaid | Points added to the additional deposit rate |
|---|---|---|
| Outside lender | Yes | 0.5 |
| Outside lender | No | Nothing |
| Cash | Either | 0.3 |
| Calloway Home Mortgage | Either | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical agreements)

- Outside lender; outside-lender deposits posted 12000.00, none returned: 0.5 points added.
- Outside lender; outside-lender deposit of 12000.00 posted and the same 12000.00 returned unpaid: posted does not exceed returned, so nothing is added.
- Cash; any deposit history: 0.3 points added.
- A collection rate of 2.0 percent with 0.5 points added becomes 2.5 percent.
